title: SQL 多表连接 (JOIN)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (8/16)：INNER JOIN、LEFT JOIN、RIGHT JOIN、CROSS JOIN、自连接与三表连接。表别名统一用 users u、orders o、products p

content.tips: users u 与 orders o 按 u.id = o.user_id 内连接（写全 INNER JOIN），取 u.name、o.amount
content.content: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

content.tips: users u 与 orders o 按 u.id = o.user_id 连接，用 JOIN 简写，取 u.name、o.amount
content.content: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

content.tips: users u 左连接 orders o（u.id = o.user_id），取 u.name、o.amount
content.content: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

content.tips: 用左连接找没有订单的用户：users u 左连 orders o（u.id = o.user_id），只取 u.name，筛 o.id 为 NULL
content.content: SELECT u.name FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.id IS NULL;

content.tips: users u 右连接 orders o（u.id = o.user_id），取 u.name、o.amount
content.content: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u RIGHT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;

content.tips: colors a 与 sizes b 交叉连接，取 a.color、b.size
content.content: SELECT a.color, b.size FROM colors a CROSS JOIN sizes b;

content.tips: users u、orders o、products p 三表连接（u.id=o.user_id，o.product_id=p.id），取 u.name、p.title、o.amount
content.content: SELECT u.name, p.title, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id;

content.tips: users u 连 orders o，ON 写 u.id = o.user_id 再 AND o.status 为 paid，取 u.name、o.amount
content.content: SELECT u.name, o.amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.status = 'paid';

content.tips: employees 自连接查上级：e 左连 m，条件 e.manager_id = m.id，取 e.name 和别名 manager 的 m.name
content.content: SELECT e.name, m.name AS manager FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id;
